thread:
Arjun: FYI nightly eval flagged a regression on the CJK name fidelity prompt set for the int8 experiment.

Arjun: Named-entity exact-match dropped a lot for zh-Hans/zh-Hant and some JA honorific mistranslations popped up.

Maya: saw the alert from @nightly-evals-bot: https://ci.redwood/ev/2026/171863/nightly-int8. Will pull artifacts.

Chen: quick examples from the failing runs (input -> model output):
- input: "\u674e\u5c0f\u9f8d\u5728\u9999\u6e2f\u51fa\u751f" -> output: "\u674e \u5728 \u9999\u6e2f\u51fa\u751f" (given name missing, extra spaces)
- input: "\u9ad8\u6a4b\u5b50\u5728\u682a\u5f0f\u4f1a\u793e\u4e2d" -> output: "\u9ad8 \u5728 \u682a\u5f0f\u4f1a\u793e" (surname split)
- input: "\u6b63\u90ce\u3055\n\u306f\u3089\u308c\n" -> output: "\u6b63\u90ce \u306f \u3089\u308c" (honorific detached / spacing noise)

Sophie: I deployed a runtime tweak yesterday that flips to packed-KV for small batches and also changed softmax clamping. I didn't touch tokenization. Could packed-KV + int8 cause token ordering differences?

Chen: I suspect either tokenization fallback changed or quantized embeddings push multi-char tokens below threshold so model prefers smaller tokens (hence splits).

Arjun: can someone reproduce locally with a single prompt and the nightly weights? Need minimal repro to bisect.

Chen: repro command I used:
```
REDWOOD_MODEL=redwood-open-nightly
REDWOOD_QUANT=INT8
python -m evals.runner --prompts tests/prompts/cjk_name_fidelity.txt --seed 7 --device a100 --batch-size 1
```
Output snippet:```
Input: \u9ad8\u6a4b\u5b50
Output: \u9ad8 \u5728
Log: attention_kv_put expected 512 got 496; topk tie-breaker switched
```

Maya: I'll diff the tokenizer artifact hashes between this nightly and the last green build and run the same eval with REDWOOD_QUANT=FP16 for comparison.

Sophie: I'll bisect the packed-KV change (range c3f9..d9a1) and run the kv cache unit tests. Also re-run softmax clamp A/B to see sensitivity to small exponent shifts.

Arjun: triage hypotheses:
- H1: tokenizer merge table or fallback changed (verify hashes)
- H2: int8 embedding quantization alters nearest-token logits for multi-char CJK tokens
- H3: packed-KV kernel bug affects prefix decode order for short prefixes

Chen: quick matrix run queued. I'll run: nightly/int8, nightly/fp16, nightly/int8+old-runtime, nightly/int8+old-tokenizer. ETA ~2h.

nightly-evals-bot: Run queued: ev-171863-7 (tests/prompts/cjk_name_fidelity.txt)

Chen: preliminary numbers from the small set (50 prompts):
- nightly/int8: NER EM 0.69
- nightly/fp16: NER EM 0.94
- old-runtime/int8: NER EM 0.91
- nightly/int8+old-tokenizer: NER EM 0.88

Arjun: looks like combination of int8 + new runtime is correlated. Tokenizer change reduces but doesn't fully explain.

Maya: mitigation proposals if confirmed:
- pin embeddings to fp16 quant profile for customers in canary
- add targeted regression check for multi-char CJK names to nightly alerts
- block rollout on >10% drop for zh/ja NER EM on the gate

Sophie: I'll aim to find the commit in the next bisect step. If packed-KV is culprit, we'll revert that change and re-run the full nightly sweep.

Chen: I'll attach token-alignment diffs (gold vs output) once the full batch finishes.

devex-bot: @Arjun created a new small-suite check: cjk_name_fidelity in nightly. Owner: Arjun.

Arjun: thanks team. Please update thread with the bisect result and attached diffs. If we have a quick rollback, run the full nightly before promoting. :thumbsup:
